name: Carbamazepine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 inhibitors (clarithromycin, erythromycin, azole antifungals, diltiazem, verapamil, cimetidine, ciprofloxacin, fluoxetine, isoniazid, omeprazole, protease inhibitors); grapefruit juice
key_interactions.action: Monitor carbamazepine levels; adjust the dose.
Adjust the dose or monitor levels.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 inducers and drugs metabolized by CYP3A4
key_interactions.effect: Carbamazepine is itself an inducer and lowers many drugs' levels; inducers lower carbamazepine (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor levels and clinical effect of both.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other liquid medicines given at the same time (chlorpromazine, thioridazine)
key_interactions.effect: Carbamazepine suspension forms a rubbery precipitate (label).
key_interactions.action: Do not give the suspension with other liquid medicines.
